errors.name: ClientNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an attempt is made to look up a client by ID that does not exist in the system.

errors.name: InvoiceNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an attempt is made to look up an invoice by ID that does not exist in the system.

errors.name: PaymentNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an attempt is made to look up a payment by ID that does not exist in the system.

errors.name: MissingClientReferenceError
errors.description: Raised when an invoice is created without a valid client ID reference.

errors.name: MissingInvoiceReferenceError
errors.description: Raised when a payment is created without a valid invoice ID reference.
